dimensions.assessment: Affects consumers with rental, utility, or telecommunication accounts, as well as furnishers of such data.
dimensions.evidence: information relating to the performance of a consumer in making payments under a lease agreement... or pursuant to a contract for a utility or telecommunications service

dimensions.assessment: Changes how consumer payment history can influence credit reporting and credit scores.
dimensions.evidence: analyzes the effect on consumer credit scores of reporting consumer cash flow data to consumer credit agencies

dimensions.assessment: Involves a GAO study and report without direct federal outlays or revenue changes.
dimensions.evidence: the Comptroller General of the United States shall submit to the Congress a report

dimensions.assessment: Amends federal statutes governing consumer credit reporting and furnisher liability rules.
dimensions.evidence: To amend the Fair Credit Reporting Act to clarify Federal law with respect to reporting certain full-file consumer credit information

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory change to credit reporting rules.

missing_information: Specific estimates of how many consumer credit scores will change or administrative costs for the GAO study.
importance_detail.rationale: Amends the Fair Credit Reporting Act to allow the reporting of positive payment information for rent, utilities, and telecommunications, while exempting energy utilities from reporting late balances if consumers meet payment plans.
